LanguageData.RCDC_EspionageLetterText: Sensors report {0} operatives converging on your data center: {1} of them, moving fast. They are not here to talk - they want to grab whatever cartridges and valuables they can carry and leave.\n\nThey will loot what they can reach and try to flee rather than fight to the end. A locked security door will slow them down like any other obstacle, but they will break through one if it is the only way in.
